alignment_reasoning: The image achieves high alignment with the 'Band Aid' class label, confirmed by the `fine_grained_classifier` (Top-1 Logit 8.02). The physical attributes (shape, color, pad/backing structure) match the taxonomy well. A real Band-Aid would have legible branding or coherent patterns. Thus, while semantically aligned, it fails the 'verisimilitude' aspect of alignment.
